newsitem.title: USA: IMM CURRENCIES END MIXED, YEN FINISHES HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: IMM CURRENCIES END MIXED, YEN FINISHES HIGHER.

text.p: Aug 6 - IMM currency futures closed mixed, with yen ending higher. Traders said yen and marks could consolidate, as short-term dollar interest seems geared to the sell side. Fed's Beige book said U.S. economy grew moderately in June/July and prices for most goods were stable, some commodities rising. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
